set_value.name: $SectorsPerShipyard
set_value.comment: one shipyard per this many sectors the Xenon own or contest, rounded up; 0 leaves the vanilla target of 4, plus 2 with Split Vendetta and 1 with Cradle of Humanity

set_value.name: $SectorsPerWharf
set_value.comment: the same for wharfs; 0 leaves the vanilla target

set_value.name: $MaxConstructions
set_value.comment: shipyards and wharfs that may be under construction at once before another is started; 0 is no limit, which is vanilla

set_value.name: $BuildChance
set_value.comment: percent chance per 1-2 minute evaluation that a missing shipyard or wharf is started; 5 is vanilla

set_value.name: $FleetSize
set_value.comment: percent of the strength an invasion gathers before it moves, and of the ceiling it may request up to; 100 is vanilla

set_value.name: $BuildShare
set_value.comment: percent of each invasion group that may be newly built rather than pulled from patrols; 25 is vanilla

set_value.name: $StationAttackGroups
set_value.comment: groups that may attack enemy stations in a Xenon or contested sector at once; 2 is vanilla

set_value.name: $LongRangeRaids
set_value.comment: 1 sends expeditions against every faction with a faction manager, not only gate neighbours; 0 is vanilla

set_value.name: $MinerBehaviour
set_value.comment: what a Xenon miner does when attacked: 0 fights back (vanilla), 1 keeps flying, 2 flees without deploying laser towers

set_value.name: $DebugChance
set_value.comment: 100 writes every evaluation to the debug log

debug_text.text: 'DrJele Xenon Pressure: sectors per shipyard %s, sectors per wharf %s, max constructions %s, build chance %s, fleet size %s, build share %s, station attack groups %s, long range raids %s, miner behaviour %s'.[$SectorsPerShipyard, $SectorsPerWharf, $MaxConstructions, $BuildChance, $FleetSize, $BuildShare, $StationAttackGroups, $LongRangeRaids, $MinerBehaviour]

check_value.comment: the faction managers only exist in the main galaxy; without this the child would poll forever in a Timelines scenario, a tutorial or the workshop map

set_value.name: $Config
set_value.exact: if global.$DrJeleXenonPressureConfig? then global.$DrJeleXenonPressureConfig else table[]

set_value.name: $DebugChance
set_value.exact: if global.$DrJeleXenonPressureDebugChance? then global.$DrJeleXenonPressureDebugChance else (if $Config.$DebugChance? then $Config.$DebugChance else 0)

set_value.name: $Raids
set_value.exact: (if global.$DrJeleXenonLongRangeRaids? then global.$DrJeleXenonLongRangeRaids else (if $Config.$LongRangeRaids? then $Config.$LongRangeRaids else 0))i

debug_text.text: 'DrJele Xenon Pressure: long range raids %s, expedition enemies %s'.[$Raids, $Enemies]
